title: FORMAT ( 12345.67, "Percent" ) has no thousand separator and no space before the sign

source.quote: FORMAT accepts a set of predefined format strings to format numbers
source.supports: the example table lists each predefined format applied to 12345.67

source.quote: Displays number multiplied by 100 with a percent sign (%) appended immediately to the right; always displays two digits to the right of the decimal separator.
source.supports: the table of predefined formats: the sign is appended immediately

source.quote: "Percent" displays the number as a percentage (multiplied by 100) with formatting and the percent sign at the right of the number separated by a single space.
source.supports: the example on the same page, which shows 1,234,567.00 %

derivation: 12345.67 * 100 = 1234567 with two decimals. DAX Guide shows 1234567.00% for this formula and the table of predefined formats on Microsoft Learn agrees (sign appended immediately, no mention of separators).
alternative: The example at the top of the Microsoft Learn page shows "1,234,567.00 %", with thousand separators and a space before the sign.
